description: This file defines the Application class in the Opencart admin startup controller namespace. It initializes various core components such as URL, customer data, currency, tax, weight, length, and shopping cart by setting them into the registry. The index method provides setup logic for these components, including tax address configuration based on settings.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: A controller class responsible for initializing core application components during startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart components; configures tax addresses based on settings.
